messages:
alex: CI red on PR #4123 — typecheck + format gate. mypy started failing after a dependency bump. Anyone around to triage?

ci-bot: CI job failed: mypy-check on commit abc1234. Logs: https://ci.redwood.example/4123/mypy-check — error excerpt below:
```
src/runtime/worker.py:45: error: Incompatible types in assignment (expression has type "None", variable has type "str")  [assignment]
src/runtime/worker.py:58: error: Argument 1 to "process" has incompatible type "Optional[str]"; expected "str"
Found 2 errors in 1 file (checked 128 source files)
```

sophia: I hit this locally too. Also noticed rustfmt changed autofixes in vendor/ — weird combo. No pyproject changes in the PR.

rui: @alex can you paste the failing lines or a small repro? I can bisect the dependency bump if it helps. Is the bump in requirements.txt or poetry.lock?

alex: Bump is in requirements.txt: `types-bot==1.3.0` (was 1.2.0). I ran a quick test: with 1.2.0 mypy passes, with 1.3.0 it fails. So likely stub tightening.

kena: That matches my hunch — some stub packs tightened Optional handling in 1.3.0. Quick workaround: add a narrow `# type: ignore[arg-type]` at the call site or cast with `cast(str, ...)` but we should prefer a minimal patch to unblock.

alex: Would prefer not to litter code. Can we pin back to 1.2.0 for now and open a follow-up to update callsites?

rui: I'll open a tiny PR that pins types-bot back in requirements.txt and add a TODO. Also will run a local bisect on the stub package to find the offending change. Command I'll use:
```
git bisect start HEAD abc1234~5
# mark good = commit-with-1.2.0, bad = commit-with-1.3.0
# run mypy-check in a loop: `mypy -p runtime`
```

alex: Thanks — can you also trigger a CI rerun after the pin PR lands? /rerun would be ideal. @ci-bot FYI. :wave:  

ci-bot: To restart checks for a PR, use: `gh actions rerun --workflow mypy-check --run-id 98765` or add the `re-run` label to the PR. 

kena: I've pushed branch `pr-4123-pin-typesbot` with the pinned requirement. Local mypy pass confirmed. @ci-bot can you kick a rerun for the PR test run?

ci-bot: Rerun requested. New run-id 98766 started.

ci-bot: Rerun complete — mypy-check passed on commit def456. All required checks green.

alex: :tada: Great — merging now. We'll track a follow-up to audit the stub changes and fix callsites instead of long-term pinning. Thanks everyone who jumped in.

sophia: I'll add a short note to the infra channel about bumping third-party stubs — they can have breaking typing changes.

rui: Filed task INFRA-839: 'Audit types-*-stubs bump impact' and linked PRs.

alex: Nice. Closing this thread.
